SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS required_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."description" AS position_description,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r."skillname", ', ' ORDER BY r."skillname") AS required_skills,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT e."degreelevel", ', ' ORDER BY e."degreelevel") AS education_requirements,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT e."fieldofstudy", ', ' ORDER BY e."fieldofstudy") AS fields_of_study
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "jobskills" js ON j."jobid" = js."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" r ON js."skillid" = r."skillid"
LEFT JOIN
    "jobeducation" je ON j."jobid" = je."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" e ON je."requirementid" = e."requirementid"
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
GROUP BY
    j."jobid", j."minimum_years", j."preferred_years", j."jobtitle", j."description";
